## Problem

Describe what happened and what you expected.

## Reproduction

Provide steps using fictional data or a blank image.

## Environment

OS, Python version and relevant dependency versions.

## Checks

Include sanitized error messages and tests run. Do not attach student photos, names, IDs,
face embeddings, model files, `.env` files, credentials or private logs.
